This infrastructure is our competitive moat, not a cost center. As Manager, Infrastructure, you will own day-to-day and quarter-to-quarter operation of that entire footprint: the team, hardware lifecycle, capacity planning, incident response, and vendor relationships. You will take over these functions directly from the Head of Cybersecurity & Infrastructure, freeing him to focus on security and multi-entity IT. This is a hands-on manager role.
